t: This is Goodge Street tube station, on Tottenham Court Road in Fitzrovia. It's on the Charing Cross branch of the Northern line, between Warren Street and Tottenham Court Road, in fare zone 1. The station was designed by Leslie Green, who is remembered for the stations he created on the Underground in central London in the first decade of the twentieth century. Look for his trademark style: oxblood red glazed blocks, pillars, and semicircular windows on the first floor.
